questions.stem: A seventeen-year-old employee finishes all study. What age condition still applies to commissioning?

questions.stem: An applicant had a notary commission revoked in another state. What stated qualification must be addressed?

questions.stem: An application uses a nickname different from the applicant's state-issued identification. What name rule applies?

The employer is not the applicant.

Page count does not resolve inconsistent execution.

feedback: A badge does not issue state office.
Supply receipts do not establish appointment.
A commercial account is not a commission.

questions.stem: A candidate relies on an older handbook reference to mailed paper forms. What current hub policy must be followed?

The hub's online-only policy for applications, renewals and stamp registration
Every old paper reference overrides current instructions

feedback: The identified route is the official portal.
Commissioning still requires filing.

The later operational policy is explicit.

questions.stem: A notary plans renewal reminders. What ordinary term does the handbook state?

feedback: Acts do not reset the term.
Correct. The ordinary commission term is four years.
That is not the stated New Mexico term.
The commission expires.

questions.stem: When may the handbook's ordinary renewal submission begin?
options: As soon as one month before expiration
Only during the first week of the term

That is not the described renewal planning period.
The handbook identifies the final-month window.
It expressly allows a pre-expiration submission.

questions.stem: A notary assumes the commission gives all public-employee immunities. What does the statute state?

feedback: The provision rejects that inference.
Assurance does not eliminate all liability.
Study does not create employment.

questions.stem: An officer refuses service on a discriminatory basis and calls it personal discretion. What statutory boundary applies?
options: A customer waiver is required before nondiscrimination applies
No discrimination in refusal or performance under the Human Rights Act
Every personal refusal is immune from law

feedback: The provision extends beyond pricing.
The legal duty does not depend on a waiver.

The discretion is legally bounded.

questions.stem: The notary's domestic partner is a party to the record. What restriction applies?

No restriction if the notary is unpaid

feedback: Consent does not erase the prohibition.
Correct. The handbook prohibits an act on the described officer/spouse/partner record.
A fee waiver does not remove the relationship interest.
Identity evidence cannot cure the separate conflict.

questions.stem: A commissioned nonlawyer offers immigration representation based only on the appointment. What authority is missing?

A seal image is a law license

feedback: Correct. The handbook lists those activities as outside the commissioned notary's authority.
The appointment does not create that profession.
Compensation cannot confer authority.
The seal identifies the office, not attorney licensure.

questions.stem: A notary uses the official title and stamp to endorse a political candidate. What does the handbook prohibit?

feedback: Lawful authentication is different.
Required records are not endorsement.
Hours do not use the office to endorse a candidate.
Correct. The handbook expressly includes promotional or opposition use for candidates.

questions.stem: An automatic officer says the eighty-percent examination requirement applies only to commissioned notaries. What does the rule state?
options: Both the notary applicant and automatic officer provide proof of eighty percent or higher

feedback: The category is included.
An oath does not replace examination proof.
Correct. The rule expressly includes automatic notarial officers.
The rule identifies the officer categories.

questions.stem: A learner sees several commercial courses. Which provider does the current SOS training page identify as approved?

Correct. The current official page names NNA as the approved provider.
Advertising alone is not approval.
Employment does not confer vendor approval.

questions.stem: An applicant pays the commission filing fee and assumes it includes training and testing. What does the rule say?

The rule expressly separates them.
Payment does not waive testing.
The applicant follows the provider payment process.

Act timing does not end vendor retention.
The rule expressly imposes retention.
Correct. The rule requires five-year retention of vendor examination records including scores.

questions.stem: SOS has prior passage on file, but the renewal applicant's commission expired more than one year ago. What exception applies?
options: Only a new seal is needed
The applicant can self-certify a pass
Training and examination must be repeated under the stated rule

feedback: Supplies do not satisfy education.
A claimed pass is not the required examination.

The rule has express exceptions.

questions.stem: A timely renewer has passed before, but SOS determines substantial legal changes occurred since the last application. What may be required?

feedback: A customer payment does not complete it.
Correct. Substantial changes determined by SOS are a separate retraining trigger.
The rule expressly preserves this trigger.
Access credentials are not education.

questions.stem: A separate RON applicant asks the passing standard for the required RON examination. What does the rule state?

feedback: Correct. The RON rule separately requires proof of at least eighty percent.
That is below the stated threshold.
Payment is not passage.
Attendance alone does not prove examination success.

questions.explanation: SOS directs inclusion of the issued certificate.
feedback: A review does not document passage.
Supplies do not prove study completion.
The official required result is distinct from practice.
Correct. SOS directs inclusion of the issued certificate.

questions.stem: A RON renewer claims that every prior ordinary notary test proves prior passage of the required remote exam. What record matters for the remote exemption?

Only an unrelated ordinary practice score

feedback: Equipment does not prove passage.
An employer cannot create the state examination record.

questions.stem: An applicant wants a fixed official exam question count and duration from the opened SOS training page. What is actually verified there?

Exactly five questions in two minutes for the ordinary exam
Exactly one hundred questions in an hour

Those metrics are not stated in the opened page.

questions.stem: A proposed ordinary application has a $5,000 bond. What required assurance amount is stated?

Education does not remove assurance.
A client deposit is not the prescribed assurance.

questions.stem: A friend offers an informal personal guarantee instead of approved assurance. What issuer condition does the statute state?
options: Any relative with a bank account
A surety or entity licensed or authorized to do business in New Mexico

feedback: Personal wealth does not establish issuer authorization.
A customer is not automatically an authorized issuer.
Course selling does not establish the statutory qualification.

questions.stem: An applicant uploads an unsigned bond draft. What execution must the surety copy contain?

The trainer cannot substitute for the principal.

Branding does not execute the bond.

questions.stem: A current notary applies for another term and wants to notarize the bond's own principal signature. What does SOS direct?

Self-notarize because the old commission is active
Only initial applicants need independent notarization

Active authority does not permit self-notarization.
The instruction covers current applicants too.

Only the promise in an email

feedback: Correct. The rule requires the prescribed executed and notarized oath.
An informal message is not that form.
Exam proof is a separate prerequisite.
A recommendation does not administer the oath.

The signed oath notarized by another current New Mexico notarial officer

feedback: Renewal does not authorize self-notarization.
Typing alone does not perform the required act.
A client is not automatically an authorized officer.

questions.stem: The portal packet contains photographs in unsupported formats instead of the required PDF uploads. What format is stated?

Postcards do not supply the electronic packet.

Only on the next four-year renewal

Renewal can be much later.

A journal entry restores the bond

Printed term dates do not remove this condition.

Documentation does not issue coverage.

Witnessing alone does not complete a jurat.

Price is not the declaration.

The act does not guarantee enforceability.

Admission of the officer as company counsel

A public name can be claimed by another person.
Scheduling does not establish identity.

Government identification is distinct from employer branding.

Fees do not identify the signer.

It is only a copy certification

Present physical signing is part of the distinction.

Customer urgency does not change the event.

Sign and date in the same manner as on file with SOS

feedback: The principal's signature is a separate element.
The officer still signs the certificate.

questions.stem: A certificate omits the acting jurisdiction and office title. What information must be present?

feedback: Price is not the missing information.

A device model does not describe public jurisdiction.
Payroll timing is not a certificate element.

questions.stem: An officer signs blank certificates before appointments. What sequence does the statute impose?

Manufacturers do not set the sequence.

questions.stem: The officer intends to write a certificate weeks after the act from memory. What timing is required?

Any time in the four-year term

Correct. The certificate is executed contemporaneously with performance.
A term is not a transaction-completion window.
The duty does not wait for a complaint.

questions.stem: A tangible certificate is completed on a loose page unrelated to the principal's record. What association is required?

Proximity does not attach it.
A label is not secure association.
A name alone does not connect the paper.

The same electronic signature and official electronic stamp for electronic acts

The signature must be the officer's.
Random identities do not reflect the commissioned person.

questions.stem: A remote digital certificate is expired although its image still looks official. What does the rule prohibit?

Appearance does not restore validity.

Payment does not cure invalid status.

questions.stem: A remote electronic certificate never says communication technology was used. What indication is needed?
questions.explanation: The rule requires that stated remote-appearance indication.
feedback: Hardware preference does not supply the statement.
Correct. The rule requires that stated remote-appearance indication.
Branding does not describe the legal act.
Payment is a different fact.

questions.stem: A new officer plans an act before filing the official stamp, believing the forty-five days permits immediate work. What does the rule require?

Wait only until the ink arrives
File only after the first complaint

Possession is different from submission.
A complaint is not the filing trigger.
The rule requires filing before first use.

questions.stem: The new officer never provides the stamp information. What consequence does the rule specify?

Referral to the State Ethics Commission

feedback: Noncompliance does not extend authority.
No new term is issued by default.
Vendors do not acquire official duties.
Correct. Failure to comply results in the stated referral.

questions.stem: A notary renews successfully and assumes the old stamp filing satisfies all future terms. What does the handbook state?

Stamp registration is required within forty-five days of renewal
No future stamp update is ever needed

An invoice does not register the actual stamp.

The handbook states the renewed-term requirement.

questions.stem: A person holds a qualifying automatic office but has completed neither training nor stamp registration. What does the handbook require before acts?
options: Complete the training and register the official stamp
Only rely on a job title

feedback: Advertising does not register a device.
Correct. The handbook expressly places those automatic-officer steps before performance.
Office status does not remove the stated duties.
Clients do not establish compliance.

options: No filing fee for automatic stamp registration

That is the ordinary assurance sum.
That belongs to a different application.
Salary does not determine the filing fee.

questions.stem: An officer changes name and contact information during the term. When must the prescribed update be submitted?

Only after the first failed delivery
Within thirty days of the change

Delivery problems do not trigger the legal deadline.
The duty belongs to the officer.

A stamp with the old name forever

Online branding does not authenticate acts.
Correct. The rule requires a stamp reflecting the amended identity.
Obsolete details do not show the updated information.

Fees are not multiplied by clients here.

questions.stem: A current notary misplaces the commission certificate. What handbook route is described?

Perform a new initial act as proof

An act does not reproduce the official certificate.
The certificate is personal.
The state assigns the appointment details.

questions.stem: A stamp no longer produces a legible impression. What amendment route does the handbook identify?
options: Only add more ink to every record
A General Amendment to replace the stamp

feedback: More ink does not necessarily create a legible device.
Devices identify their own officers.
The official impression must remain usable.
Correct. The handbook describes replacement through General Amendment.

questions.stem: An approved remote officer waits to send the electronic stamp until after a first RON. What does the rule require?
options: Only show it to the client
SOS receives it before the first RON and within forty-five days of authorization
Only upload it at the next renewal

feedback: Client viewing is not state receipt.
Private storage does not file it.
Correct. The rule explicitly combines receipt before first RON with the forty-five-day limit.
The initial authorization has its own deadline.

questions.stem: A RON application includes an unreadable stamp image with no authentication instructions. What supporting item is required?
options: Necessary provider instructions or techniques to read and authenticate the signature and stamp

feedback: Stationery cannot make the image readable.
Correct. The application rule calls for the relevant reading/authentication instructions.
Marketing text does not authenticate credentials.
Billing does not supply technical verification.

questions.stem: A provider was approved years ago but its current status is unknown. When must an officer check active status?
options: Before using it for each remote notarization
questions.explanation: The rule expressly extends active-status verification to every RON.
feedback: Correct. The rule expressly extends active-status verification to every RON.
Old approval does not establish current status.
Billing is not the legal trigger.
The check precedes the act.

questions.stem: A notary posts the official stamp image publicly as an advertisement. What does the fraud-prevention rule state?
options: Publish it if the image is small
Publish it after charging a fee
Do not share or publish the official stamp
questions.explanation: The rule prohibits sharing or publishing the official stamp.
feedback: Size does not create an exception.
Payment does not authorize publication.
The prohibition is not limited to paper.
Correct. The rule prohibits sharing or publishing the official stamp.

questions.stem: The officer resigns but leaves an active device for the successor. What must happen to the old device?
options: Keep it usable for emergency clients
Let the successor use its expiration date
Render it unusable by the statutory disabling methods
Transfer the personal authority with it
questions.explanation: The statute requires disabling the device when the specified authority ends.
feedback: Emergency demand does not preserve authority.
Another officer cannot inherit the appointment.
Correct. The statute requires disabling the device when the specified authority ends.
A stamp does not transfer a commission.

questions.stem: An officer records only high-value acts and omits free routine acts. What scope does the rule require?

feedback: Entries do not await disputes.

No-fee service is not an exemption.
The duty is broader than real estate.

questions.stem: An entry has a date but no time. What timing detail does the official page require?

Appointment timing is different.
Payment may occur at another time.

questions.stem: A journal says only 'customer service.' What description is missing?

feedback: Pay does not identify the act.
A vehicle model is unrelated.
Branding does not describe the service.

The recipient may not be a principal.

Record the fee if any while retaining the act entry duty

Invented charges misdescribe the transaction.

PDF entries available to the public or State Ethics Commission

Only a text to the last client

Clients do not replace state notice.

A record copy does not issue authority.

Visitors are not automatic custodians.
A promise alone does not secure the record.

That stated media split, subject to the journal requirements
No electronic journal in any case

feedback: Customer-specific fragmentation is not the stated proviso.
Correct. The proviso expressly allows that paper/electronic division.

questions.stem: An officer resigns while the last journal act is recent. How is the retention period measured?
options: Ten years after the last chronicled act regardless of officer status
Ten years after the first page
Only until the stamp is destroyed

Resignation does not terminate it.

Device disposal is separate from journal retention.
